title: OpenL3 Embeddings
text: Extract OpenL3 embeddings, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Spectrum type} sets Type of spectrum Mel; {Sample rate of input signal (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input signal, {Overlap percentage (%)} sets the overlap percentage between consecutive, {Content type} sets the type of audio content and {Embedding length} sets the output embedding length. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Sample rate of input signal (Hz)
params.values: Sample rate of input signal in Hz 48e3 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Spectrum type
params.values: Type of spectrum Mel (128 bands) (default) | Mel (256 bands) | Linear

params.name: Content type
params.values: Type of audio content Environmental sounds (default) | Musical sounds
